logistic_regression_zero_alert_investiga.root_cause_analysis: Platt sigmoid calibrator maps raw log-odds onto the empirical base rate of the validation cohort (~2.7%). As a result, the maximum predicted calibrated probability on the holdout cohort is bounded at 0.0699.
logistic_regression_zero_alert_investiga.technical_classification: Expected mathematical consequence of Platt scaling with severe class imbalance; no score exceeds the arbitrary 0.0800 cutoff.
